verdict.rationale: ROS 2 supplies the building blocks for teleoperation. Topics carry continuous sensor streams, QoS policies are documented for non-ideal networks (from TCP-like reliable to UDP-like best-effort), and a long-time user says teleop comes 'for free' with the ecosystem. However, nothing in the pack documents an end-to-end remote teleop workflow, live video streaming, or performance over real WAN links, so assembling one takes additional tools and integration. Missing for 10: documented live video/image streaming and compression, remote access over the internet or across NAT, latency/responsiveness evidence for control over real-world networks, a first-party teleop tool or UI, and hands-on corroboration.
